combat_progression.rationale: The source implements two enemy types, hit points, score values, collision damage, lives, and score/time-based difficulty escalation. The retained evidence does not show richer wave, boss, power-up, or upgrade progression.
evidence: app.js:23-27 shows enemy types, projectile collisions, scoring, damage, and game-over flow.
game-core.js:7-13 and test.log show escalating difficulty with spawn-rate and speed caps.
automated.json records projectileCount 2 and enemyCount 4 during evaluator interaction.

visual_design.rationale: Strong, coherent neon arcade art direction with readable hierarchy, responsive composition, glow/scanline treatment, animated canvas particles, and mobile controls. A small deduction reflects simple geometric gameplay art and limited retained combat-effect screenshots.
evidence: desktop-before.png visibly shows the cyan/magenta wordmark, bordered cabinet, HUD, hero overlay, and structured leaderboard panel.
desktop-after.png visibly shows the active glowing cyan ship, dense starfield/scanlines, live leaderboard update, and mute-state change.
mobile.png visibly shows a readable single-column layout with directional pad, FIRE control, leaderboard, and footer.
styles.css:1 and app.js:29-32 define the neon palette, responsive layout, scanlines, glows, sprites, stars, and particle effects.

resilience_accessibility.rationale: The app provides loading, empty, offline, validation, success, and retry states while keeping gameplay available, and includes meaningful labels and reduced-motion handling.
evidence: app.js:40-41 implements loading, empty, registry-offline, invalid-name, transmission-success, and transmission-failure states.
index.html:14-45 includes labels, aria-labels, aria-live, and aria-pressed attributes; styles.css:1 includes prefers-reduced-motion handling.
automated.json reports 7 labeled elements and zero console/page errors.

data_security.rationale: The checked-in migration demonstrates RLS, constrained anonymous permissions, database-side validation, and no update/delete policy; the client exposes only a publishable key. Retained logs prove the allowed remote GET/POST/reload path, but contain no negative remote probe for rejected invalid data or unauthorized operations.
evidence: supabase/migrations/001_leaderboard.sql:6-14 defines name/score constraints and enables RLS.
supabase/migrations/001_leaderboard.sql:16-33 restricts anon access to selected-column reads and name/score inserts, with no update/delete policy.
app.js:3-4 and README.md:32 show use of a publishable key and no service-role credential in the client bundle.
automated.json records real Supabase GET 200, POST 201, and subsequent GET 200 requests with persisted leaderboard data.

engineering_quality.rationale: Build, lint, and tests pass; gameplay rules are separated into a tested core module and dependencies are pinned. Coverage is intentionally small and the highly compressed one-line app/styles source reduces maintainability.
evidence: build.log, lint.log, and test.log show successful build/lint execution and 3 passing Node tests.
package.json:6-15 defines repeatable test, lint, build, check, and deploy scripts with wrangler pinned to 4.120.0.
game-core.js and test/game-core.test.js separate and exercise collision, difficulty, and validation logic.
package-lock.json:2-14 is present with lockfileVersion 3 and the pinned wrangler dependency.

reproducibility.rationale: The handoff is complete beyond the result artifact: local setup, controls, architecture, deployment, security decisions, migration, scripts, tests, lockfile, and built source are all retained.
evidence: README.md:5-15 documents setup and the check workflow; README.md:17-34 documents controls, architecture, and security behavior.
README.md:36-49 documents schema application, Cloudflare deployment, project naming, and production URL.
source-manifest.txt lists source, dist, migration, test, build, package, and README artifacts.
build.log and test.log provide factual successful verification, while automated.json validates the result artifact and live application checks.

summary: Strong polished and functional submission with complete handoff and good database design; points are withheld for limited progression depth, sparse automated coverage, compressed maintainability, and missing retained negative Supabase security probes.
